recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical cross-stitch sampler on off-white Aida cloth, featuring a dense arrangement of disparate icons including revolvers, hearts, flowers, animals, and figures, framed by a geometric border and anchored by bold, blocky pixelated typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-locked alignment of all elements to the textile weave
Symmetrical mirroring of icons across a vertical central axis
High-contrast relationship between the cream fabric and vibrant primary-colored threads
Juxtaposition of traditional domestic craft with modern or unexpected iconography
coreInvariants: Visible X-shaped stitch texture in all colored areas
Strictly horizontal and vertical alignment of elements
Off-white or cream-colored woven fabric background
Geometric border composed of repeating star or cross motifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central diamond icon acts as the focal point, surrounded by medium-scale icons, with large display text at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red block-lettering at the bottom provides a heavy visual base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top header text, down through the symmetrical icon field, to the heavy bottom text, and finally to the fine alphabet row.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Evenly distributed small gaps between icons maintain the grid-like clarity of the sampler.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark brown for outlines and heavy text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary red, forest green, and royal blue for decorative elements
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors against a neutral, low-value background to simulate dyed embroidery floss.
paletteRestrictions: No gradients; solid blocks of color only

letterConstructionRules: All glyphs must be constructed from square 'pixels' representing cross-stitches
Display text uses thick, 5-7 stitch wide strokes
Secondary text uses single-stitch thin lines
No curves; all diagonals must be stepped
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and D characters are octagonal blocks
Serifs are represented as single-pixel extensions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy block display text paired with delicate monolinear alphabet strings.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, grid-based construction of the red text.
Matches the top header's heavy, gothic-influenced pixel style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution texture of cream-colored Aida cloth. On this background, place a variety of small, symmetrical folk-art icons (flowers, animals, hearts) rendered in a pixelated cross-stitch style using primary colors. Include a geometric blue and green border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text: a heavy black pixelated gothic header, a large red block-letter slab serif footer, and a thin black monolinear alphabet at the very bottom. Ensure all text has a visible 'X' stitch texture.

verificationChecks: Is the texture of individual cross-stitches visible?
Are all elements aligned to a consistent grid?
Is the background a realistic woven fabric?

postGenerationChecks: Check that no text is blurry or anti-aliased.
Ensure the 'X' pattern is consistent across all colored areas.
Verify the symmetry of the left and right icon groups.
Confirm the fabric weave is visible in the negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a [subject] in the style of a traditional cross-stitch sampler, using a [color palette] on [fabric type] background, featuring [specific icons] arranged symmetrically with [typography style] text.
